description:
Fix ISS-020: chunked reviews assert cross-file claims about code they cannot see, producing plausible-but-wrong findings. THIS IS AN EXPERIMENT TICKET — measure before committing to a design; do not just implement option A because it is listed first.

## The failure mode (understand it first)
`chunkDiff` (src/utils/chunking.ts) splits large diffs on file boundaries; each chunk is reviewed in isolation (chunk loop in `runCodeReview`, src/backends/orchestrator.ts — see the chunking flow comments ~lines 187-220). A call site lands in chunk 1, its implementation in chunk 3 → the reviewer confidently asserts "X is called with an empty set and there's no guard" when the guard is literally line 1 of the implementation it can't see. Live evidence: a 5-chunk, 1,664-line prod diff returned 10/10 false-positive findings, several of this exact shape (details in ISS-020). Both providers are wrong the same way, so deliberation agreement CANNOT filter these (they agree on the wrong claim).

## Step 1 — Build the measurement harness FIRST
Reconstruct the reference diff: `git diff cdd1776~7..cdd1776` in this repo reproduces the Hardening-phase diff that produced 10/10 false positives (verify it chunks into >1 chunk with the default max_chunk_tokens; if not, lower max_chunk_tokens in a scratch config). Ground truth: all 10 findings from that review were verified false (list in ISS-020 + the 2026-07-01 handover). Metric: false-positive count on this diff, before vs after, same provider + model, 2 runs each (LLM variance is real — single runs mislead; see the 2026-07-02 handover nondeterminism note).

## Step 2 — Candidate mitigations to evaluate (combinable)
(a) **Cross-chunk manifest**: when a review is chunked, inject into each chunk's prompt a compact listing of the OTHER chunks: file paths + hunk headers (@@ lines) + added/changed function signatures (greppable from '+' lines matching function/const/export patterns — a heuristic is fine, it's context not truth). Wire through `buildCodeReviewPrompt` (src/review/prompts.ts) via a new optional prompt section; plumb from the chunk loop where per-chunk prompts are built. Cost: tokens — measure prompt size growth; keep the manifest under ~10% of chunk budget, truncating file-list-first.
(b) **Epistemic instruction**: add to the chunked-review prompt: findings that depend on code NOT visible in this chunk (other files' implementations, interfaces, types) must be marked with a `cross_file: true` flag or category, and phrased as "verify that…" not asserted. Requires a schema field — if you add one, L-014 applies: every property `required` recursively in the model-facing schema, keep the recursive lock test in orchestrator.test.ts green, live-probe Codex once.
(c) **Post-merge downgrade pass** (pure code, no prompt change): after merging chunk results, for each finding whose `file` is present in the SUBMITTED diff but was NOT in the finding's own chunk — the reviewer referenced a file it never saw — downgrade severity one step and prefix the description with "[cross-chunk, unverified]". Needs the chunk→files mapping, available from chunkDiff's output at the call site.

## Step 3 — Decide with data
Run the harness per variant (and a+c combined). Pick the best FP reduction that doesn't suppress TRUE findings — plant 2 real bugs in a copy of the reference diff to check recall stays intact. Record the numbers in the ticket resolution and a storybloq note.

## Step 4 — Implement the winner + tests
Unit tests colocated (chunk manifest construction, downgrade-pass file/chunk mapping, prompt assembly). Integration test at the orchestrator level with a mocked SDK boundary ONLY (never mock chunking itself — prod-realistic rule). Full gate green.

## Acceptance
- Measured FP reduction on the reference diff reported with before/after counts (2 runs each).
- Planted true-positive recall unchanged.
- Single-chunk reviews completely unaffected (assert: no manifest/no downgrade when chunks_reviewed is absent or 1).
- Resolves ISS-020 with the numbers in the resolution.

## Conventions
TypeScript strict, no `any`; Result<T> over throws; ESM `.js` suffixes; TDD; no AI names in commits.
title: Cross-chunk review context: stop plausible-but-wrong cross-file findings on chunked diffs (ISS-020)
